notes: Compare results within each reference-frame group; frame-15 runs have later observed input than the website benchmark.
The original frame-3 stride-2 runs use only frames 1 and 3 from the original four inputs.
Historical published one-step controls ran a fixed 40 epochs; published MST and new runs use validation early stopping.
Standard deviations describe variation across three training seeds, not uncertainty from resampling networks.

selection.criterion: Highest mean validation Poisson R2 at 100 original-frame intervals over seeds 0, 1, 2
